Yugoslavia ( / ˌ j uː ɡ oʊ ˈ s l ɑː v i ə / ; lit. ' Land of the South Slavs ' ) [ a ] was a country in Central Europe and the Balkans [ 6 ] that existed from 1918 to 1992. It came into existence following World War I , [ b ] under the name of the Kingdom of Serbs, Croats and Slovenes , from the merger of the Kingdom of Serbia with the provisional State of Slovenes, Croats and Serbs , and constituted the first union of South Slavic peoples as a sovereign state , following centuries of foreign rule over the region under the Ottoman Empire and the Habsburg monarchy .
